definitions.explanation: Describes something with a soft, airy texture that feels pleasant to touch or has a light, floating quality.
Describes a light, floating or drifting motion, as if suspended in air.

notes:
ふわふわ is a ⟦{擬態語|ぎたいご}→擬態語：22468_gitaigo⟧ (mimetic word) describing soft, light, airy texture or gentle floating motion. It has two core uses: physical softness (sense 1) and light floating (sense 2).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ふわふわ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜: fluffy/soft (noun modifier)
- ふわふわした〜: soft and fluffy (adjectival)
- ふわふわ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to feel soft and fluffy
- ふわふわ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{浮|う}かぶ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧: to float lightly
- ふわふわ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧: to drift down gently (snow, petals)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦もこもこ→もこもこ：05361_mokomoko⟧: fluffy, puffy (thicker, bulkier — think winter coats or thick fur)
- ⟦ふかふか→ふかふか：10475_fukafuka⟧: soft and cushy (like a mattress, cushion, or carpet)
- ⟦ふわっと→ふわっと：06254_fuwatto⟧: a single light, soft motion (one-time version of ふわふわ)

TYPICAL THINGS DESCRIBED AS ふわふわ:
⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧ (bread), ⟦パンケーキ→パンケーキ：28809_pankeeki⟧ (pancakes), ⟦タオル→タオル：01533_taoru⟧ (towels), ⟦{毛布|もうふ}→毛布：03630_moufu⟧ (blankets), ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{毛|け}→毛：01392_ke⟧ (cat fur), ⟦{雲|くも}→雲：02202_kumo⟧ (clouds).
